DEPTH_CLAIM_BLEND: SELECTED on out-of-sample skill over 42 weeks and CONFIRMED on 28 untouched weeks. See the note at the definition. Not declared.
DK: DraftKings classic scoring, read from contest rules.
PRIOR_WEIGHT_CAP: SELECTED on out-of-sample skill over 42 weeks and CONFIRMED on 28 untouched weeks. See the note at the definition. Not declared.
TEAM_VOLUME_PRIOR_GAMES: DECLARED pseudo-games of prior-season club volume.
THROUGH_SEASON: Hard holdout boundary. Every prior and rate is fitted at or before this season so 2026 can test the model.

HOLDOUT: every prior and every rate is fitted at or before 2025. The 2026 weeks enter only as current-season evidence with declared weight, never as training data, so forward-chained evaluation on unseen 2026 weeks remains honest.

Part of this spread is predictable and already priced. Using it as the conditional spread pulls the points-allowed expectation toward the middle buckets, so the term is conservative: it understates a strong defence facing a weak offence and overstates the reverse. OUT-036 would fix it.

44246751.TWO_PART_SEMANTICS: dk_points is UNCONDITIONAL: P(plays) times what he does if he plays. It is the right object for an expected value and it is wrong for both subgroups -- measured out of sample it is 2.44 low on players who appeared and 3.54 high on players who did not. dk_points_if_plays is CONDITIONAL, computed by a second allocation in which every candidate is treated as playing, and is what a lineup consumes. Neither replaces the other.

carries.APPEARANCE_SEMANTICS: claim is share GIVEN he plays; this is P(he plays) at his depth rank, so the product is unconditional.

44247014.TWO_PART_SEMANTICS: dk_points is UNCONDITIONAL: P(plays) times what he does if he plays. It is the right object for an expected value and it is wrong for both subgroups -- measured out of sample it is 2.44 low on players who appeared and 3.54 high on players who did not. dk_points_if_plays is CONDITIONAL, computed by a second allocation in which every candidate is treated as playing, and is what a lineup consumes. Neither replaces the other.

carries.APPEARANCE_SEMANTICS: claim is share GIVEN he plays; this is P(he plays) at his depth rank, so the product is unconditional.

targets.APPEARANCE_SEMANTICS: claim is share GIVEN he plays; this is P(he plays) at his depth rank, so the product is unconditional.

explanation.ORDER_MATTERS: a nested decomposition credits shared effect to whichever stage comes first. The order is fixed and runs least player-specific to most game-specific. This is not a Shapley value.
explanation.name: Gregory Desrosiers

not_modelled.opponent_adjustment: opponent strength is not yet a model input. Reported as NOT_MODELLED rather than 0.0, because a zero would assert that the opponent does not matter.
not_modelled.teammate_absence: the redistribution study measures this from history (nfl/warehouse/REDISTRIBUTION_STUDY.json) and is not yet wired into the projection, so no contribution is claimed for it.
not_modelled.weather_adjustment: weather is carried in the warehouse and is not yet a projection input. Same reasoning.

44247514.EFFECTIVELY_ZERO_NOTE: below 0.05 DK points, which is not distinguishable from zero for lineup purposes. The value is kept at full precision so it cannot be confused with a refusal.
44247514.TWO_PART_SEMANTICS: dk_points is UNCONDITIONAL: P(plays) times what he does if he plays. It is the right object for an expected value and it is wrong for both subgroups -- measured out of sample it is 2.44 low on players who appeared and 3.54 high on players who did not. dk_points_if_plays is CONDITIONAL, computed by a second allocation in which every candidate is treated as playing, and is what a lineup consumes. Neither replaces the other.

carries.APPEARANCE_SEMANTICS: claim is share GIVEN he plays; this is P(he plays) at his depth rank, so the product is unconditional.

targets.APPEARANCE_SEMANTICS: claim is share GIVEN he plays; this is P(he plays) at his depth rank, so the product is unconditional.

44284151.name: Cody Hardy

rz_intensity.SEMANTICS: red-zone opportunities per unit of his own volume, so it is invariant to how much volume he is finally allocated.

44284153.EFFECTIVELY_ZERO_NOTE: below 0.05 DK points, which is not distinguishable from zero for lineup purposes. The value is kept at full precision so it cannot be confused with a refusal.
44284153.TWO_PART_SEMANTICS: dk_points is UNCONDITIONAL: P(plays) times what he does if he plays. It is the right object for an expected value and it is wrong for both subgroups -- measured out of sample it is 2.44 low on players who appeared and 3.54 high on players who did not. dk_points_if_plays is CONDITIONAL, computed by a second allocation in which every candidate is treated as playing, and is what a lineup consumes. Neither replaces the other.

carries.APPEARANCE_SEMANTICS: claim is share GIVEN he plays; this is P(he plays) at his depth rank, so the product is unconditional.

targets.APPEARANCE_SEMANTICS: claim is share GIVEN he plays; this is P(he plays) at his depth rank, so the product is unconditional.

explanation.ORDER_MATTERS: a nested decomposition credits shared effect to whichever stage comes first. The order is fixed and runs least player-specific to most game-specific. This is not a Shapley value.
explanation.name: Luke Basso

not_modelled.opponent_adjustment: opponent strength is not yet a model input. Reported as NOT_MODELLED rather than 0.0, because a zero would assert that the opponent does not matter.
not_modelled.teammate_absence: the redistribution study measures this from history (nfl/warehouse/REDISTRIBUTION_STUDY.json) and is not yet wired into the projection, so no contribution is claimed for it.
not_modelled.weather_adjustment: weather is carried in the warehouse and is not yet a projection input. Same reasoning.
